scripts.typecheck: uv run pyright && uv run pyrefly check . && uv run ty check .
scripts.check:all: npm run format:check && npm run lint:md && uv run ruff format . --check && uv run ruff check . && npm run typecheck
scripts.fix:all: npm run format && npm run lint:md:fix && uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
